card.name: Start of treat- words, split apart
card.fires_on: The first piece of a split-up word like treatment, treated or pretreatment, such as a lone T, -T or pret, usually in all-caps warnings or oddly spaced table text. It also fires on the word before it, as in EMERGENCY.

modes.label: Split TREATMENT in caps
modes.description: A capital T or the word EMERGENCY just before the rest of TREATMENT in anaphylaxis warnings.
modes.example: SERIOUS ANAPHYLACTOID REACTIONS REQUIRE IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY<< T>>REATMENT WITH EPINEPHRINE

modes.label: Split treated or pretreatment
modes.description: A cut-off start of treated, retreatment or pretreated in running label text.
modes.example: Isoniazid Isoniazid 300 mg/day<< pret>>reatment for 1 week did not significantly

modes.label: Spaced table text
modes.description: A lone T before reatment in tables with odd spacing.
modes.example: Maximum I njection V olume per<< T>> reatme n t V isit

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated pieces such as tr and tre, so it adds no clear output effect beyond a weak tr- start.
card.plain: It lights up when the word treatment or treated is broken up and only its first letter or two has appeared.
